## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S2. This is audit backlog UX-07 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /front-desk cards; the queue display; /today · receptionist, nurse, doctor.
Findings and reviewers: F-05 · reviewer A-06.
Rationale: Call in and Consult done are single taps with no confirmation and no undo. The desk closed a visit while the doctor's consultation stayed open. A walk-in who leaves must be pushed through to Done, which records a visit that never happened; the display calls the wrong token and the counts are wrong.
Proposed UX behaviour: After any move a status line offers Undo for 30 seconds, or until the next move; the server refuses an undo after the window. A card menu offers Left without being seen and Cancel visit, each with a reason; both remove the token from the queue display and are counted apart from Done. When a consultation is open for the visit, the desk's Consult done is replaced by With the doctor (no action), and In consult and Done follow the doctor's Start and End; the desk buttons stay for clinics whose doctors do not use the consultation screen. Two people changing one visit: the second is told the state changed, not silently overwritten. Every reversal and new end state is audited.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, receptionist view, Undo last move (audit note 10); screenshot docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/desk-1440-checked-in.png.
Components and tokens affected: Board card menu and status line; the existing Dialog for reasons. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Back end: reverse transitions with rules and audit, two new end states, the open-consultation guard, a version check on visit state. Front end: undo line, card menu, With the doctor. ERD and state-machine docs regenerated if a column or state is added.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None in code. Product decision: who marks in the room and done.
Clinical sign-off: Not clinical sign-off, but two decisions block merge: questions 11 and 12 of the validation plan (pilot doctor and receptionist), recorded on the issue. Safe acceptance criterion 4 applies: the receptionist recovers from a wrong Call in without help.
Effort and regression risk: L · Medium: the visit state machine is used by the board, the display, Today and the metrics.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Reopening a completed and signed visit. (2) A no-show change (exists). (3) Drag and drop. (4) The board's chrome (track D).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a card moved by Call in, when Undo is pressed within 30 seconds, then the card is back in Ready for doctor with the same token
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a move older than the window or followed by another move, when an undo is sent, then the server refuses it
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a checked-in walk-in, when the desk marks Left without being seen with a reason, then the token leaves the queue display and the visit is not counted as done
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an open consultation for the visit, when the desk views the card, then it reads With the doctor with no action, and a direct API call to close it is refused
- [ ] **AC5.** Given an undo or a new end state, when the queue display and Today are watched, then both follow within one live update
- [ ] **AC6.** Given any undo, cancel or left-without-being-seen, when the audit log is read, then it holds who, when, the reason and the previous state
- [ ] **AC7.** Given the integration tests, when the window rule or the open-consultation guard is removed, then a test fails
- [ ] **AC8.** Given the walk-in path, when it is measured, then it is still at most 6 clicks new and 3 returning; and the card menu works by keyboard with no axe violation in English or Arabic

## Test notes

- Integration (real PostgreSQL): transitions, window, guard, tenant isolation, audit rows.
- Playwright J3 new steps (tests/e2e/fullstack/j3.spec.ts): Call in → Undo → card back in Ready for doctor; mark left → card gone from the display list; desk cannot close a visit with an open consultation.
- tests/e2e/queue-tv.spec.ts and front-desk.spec.ts updated.
